description: Fill and UV projections of bitmap sources (04 section 4, 5; task phase1.8_compositor-sources-projection): UV transform, Nearest and bilinear filters in the evaluator's arithmetic, wrap modes and island edges, with residuals of the evaluator's output against both recordings. Supersedes resampling.json for the evaluator.

entries.subject: UV projection with the Nearest filter (Repeat), any scale
entries.formula: Output texel (i, j) of the W x H set at u = (i + 0.5)/W, v = 1 - (j + 0.5)/H; (a, b) = ((u - 0.5) s_u, (v - 0.5) s_v); u' = (cos r a + sin r b + 0.5) - o_u, v' = (-sin r a + cos r b + 0.5) - o_v, in double; bitmap texel coordinates x = u' w - 0.5, y = (1 - v') h - 0.5 (row 0 on top, centres at integers). The texel (floor(x + 0.5) mod w, floor(y + 0.5) mod h); its value float32(c / M) stored with the channel's write rule (the code itself at equal depth).

entries.subject: UV projection with BilinearHQ and BilinearSharp (Repeat), magnification and 1:1
entries.formula: Output texel (i, j) of the W x H set at u = (i + 0.5)/W, v = 1 - (j + 0.5)/H; (a, b) = ((u - 0.5) s_u, (v - 0.5) s_v); u' = (cos r a + sin r b + 0.5) - o_u, v' = (-sin r a + cos r b + 0.5) - o_v, in double; bitmap texel coordinates x = u' w - 0.5, y = (1 - v') h - 0.5 (row 0 on top, centres at integers). Fixed point: X = floor(256 x + 0.5), x0 = X >> 8, fx = X & 255 (same for y); weights w11 = (fx fy + 127) >> 8, w10 = fx - w11, w01 = fy - w11, w00 = 256 - fx - fy + w11 on the taps (x0, y0), (x0 + 1, y0), (x0, y0 + 1), (x0 + 1, y0 + 1); texels t = float32(c / 65535); value = float32 of the exact sum of (w / 256) t (one rounding), stored with the channel's write rule. Repeat: tap indices modulo the bitmap size. BilinearHQ and BilinearSharp are identical here.

entries.notes: One value differs, by one code, in s0 and s1 user2 (scale 1.37 x 2.11), both recordings: its exact sum lies 2^-34.7 above the midpoint between two float32 values and Painter rounded it down; no fixed-point truncation of the sum (26 to 41 bits) or texel conversion variant reproduces it without breaking others. Replaces the 20-bit integer value rule of resampling.json (about 280 values per map one code off).

entries.subject: UV projection with BilinearHQ and RepeatNone, magnification and 1:1
entries.formula: Output texel (i, j) of the W x H set at u = (i + 0.5)/W, v = 1 - (j + 0.5)/H; (a, b) = ((u - 0.5) s_u, (v - 0.5) s_v); u' = (cos r a + sin r b + 0.5) - o_u, v' = (-sin r a + cos r b + 0.5) - o_v, in double; bitmap texel coordinates x = u' w - 0.5, y = (1 - v') h - 0.5 (row 0 on top, centres at integers). Fixed point: X = floor(256 x + 0.5), x0 = X >> 8, fx = X & 255 (same for y); weights w11 = (fx fy + 127) >> 8, w10 = fx - w11, w01 = fy - w11, w00 = 256 - fx - fy + w11 on the taps (x0, y0), (x0 + 1, y0), (x0, y0 + 1), (x0 + 1, y0 + 1); texels t = float32(c / 65535); value = float32 of the exact sum of (w / 256) t (one rounding), stored with the channel's write rule. RepeatNone: tap indices clamped to the bitmap; texels with u' or v' outside [0, 1) are not covered and keep the value below the fill (a coverage plane in the projected tile). RepeatHorizontally / RepeatVertically repeat one axis and treat the other as RepeatNone (not observed).

entries.subject: UV projections on meshes: island edges
entries.formula: The Fill and UV projections evaluate every texel of the UV tile, inside and outside the islands. On every texel whose centre a triangle of the texture set covers (the UV raster of src/render/uv_raster.h on the imported texturing mesh) the channel equals the export; the texels outside the islands are export padding (padding infinite), not the stack's value.
